links.comparator_used: Fixed 0.5 probability cut-off for assigning case complexity
links.outcome: Prediction accuracy of case complexity (standard vs complex) for stratifying patients to high- or low-intensity CBT
links.effect: Accuracy 0.749 with the ROC-derived cut-off vs 0.690 with the 0.5 cut-off
links.tradeoff: The models showed large sensitivity and specificity trade-offs that change the rates of assignment to high-intensity CBT, so the choice of cut-off matters when implementing the models.
links.quote: The ROC cut-off achieved the highest prediction accuracy of case complexity (0.749).
